title: Compiler warnings as findings
summary: A warning the build enables is a finding unless the checks turn it off
prose: The compiler warnings a unit's command enables are findings, reported under their `clang-diagnostic-<flag>` name, as clang-tidy reports them. A `Checks` starting with `-*`, as here, turns them off but for those it names.

value.stdout:
${WS}/main.cpp:2:9: warning: unused variable 'unused' [clang-diagnostic-unused-variable]
Linted 1 translation unit in #s: 1 finding.
